item.title: I'll tell my players to dive in future - Iraola
item.description: Andoni Iraola says that he will tell his players to go down in future after Liverpool were denied a penalty in Sunday's defeat by Arsenal.

item.title: From Fleetwood embarrassment to 'magical' Anfield win 14 years in making
item.description: Arsenal bounce back from the low of defeat at League Two Fleetwood to secure their first win in 14 years at Anfield - and open up a three-point lead at the top of the Premier League.

item.title: Arsenal move clear at the top with a rare win at Liverpool
item.description: Arsenal win at Anfield for the first time since 2012 to earn a three-point lead at the top of the Premier League table following an end-to-end match that leaves Liverpool frustrated to have taken nothing.

item.title: Rice rewarded, Wirtz must do more - Liverpool and Arsenal player ratings
item.description: How Liverpool and Arsenal's players rated in their Premier League match at Anfield, as the champions of the past two seasons went head to head.

item.title: Giant curiosity Hibs finally liberated from Hearts sucker punch
item.description: Hibernian, for once, avoid late heartbreak to set up League Cup final with Rangers, writes Tom English.

item.title: Are Celtic club in regression amid run of six defeats in 10?
item.description: Chris Sutton and Ian McCall weigh in on Celtic after a second league defeat of the season, but manager Martin O'Neill is defiant.

item.title: Boy, 14, hands himself into police over Bradley Lowery video
item.description: A 14-year-old has handed himself into West Midlands Police after Coventry City said they were investigating a video appearing to show a fan taunting Sunderland supporters with a picture of Bradley Lowery.

item.title: 'Everyone saw it' - Iraola confused by Isak penalty decision
item.description: Liverpool manager Andoni Iraola reacts to his side's defeat at home to league leaders Arsenal, saying he "doesn't understand" why Alexander Isak was not awarded a penalty.

item.title: Bellingham & Mbappe score as Real Madrid earn statement win
item.description: Kylian Mbappe, Jude Bellingham and Yan Diomande score as Real Madrid cruise to a 3-0 win against Racing Santander, moving only three points behind Barcelona at the top of La Liga.

item.title: Arteta credits Fleetwood loss for spirited win at Anfield
item.description: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta believes their loss in the League Cup by Fleetwood spurred his side on to their first victory at Anfield in 14 years.

item.title: Chelsea put six past Charlton to top WSL
item.description: Ruthless Chelsea put six goals past Charlton - who are yet to earn a point in the WSL this season - to return to the top of the table with 27 goals in just eight games.

item.title: Clinical Man City edge past London City in WSL thriller
item.description: Manchester City earn a dramatic victory courtesy of goals from Khadija Shaw and Lauren Hemp against an excellent but wasteful London City Lionesses side.

item.title: Spence 'very proud' to break WSL appearance record
item.description: Tottenham midfielder Drew Spence says it is a "very proud moment" to become the Women's Super League's all-time appearance record holder.

item.title: Are Manchester United really at risk of a relegation scrap?
item.description: Manchester United's current tally of seven points from nine games would not even get them 30 points if it was continued for the full season.

item.title: Warnock hid seizures from Liverpool as a youngster
item.description: Former Premier League footballer Stephen Warnock says he hid seizures from Liverpool as a youngster because he feared he would be released.

item.title: Defeat for London City - but is Europe a real possibility?
item.description: London City Lionesses suffer defeat by Manchester City but their performance suggests they are closer to Champions League qualification than expected.

item.title: Are De Zerbi's Spurs finding elusive consistency?
item.description: Are Spurs finally finding elusive consistency under Roberto de Zerbi after a third successive Premier League win, asks chief football writer Phil McNulty?

item.title: Retired Sheff Utd legend Sharp signs for Rushden
item.description: Former Sheffield United and Doncaster Rovers striker Billy Sharp comes out of retirement to join Northern Premier League side AFC Rushden & Diamonds as they prepare for their FA Cup match against Burton Albion.

item.title: Third choice? Inside Alexander-Arnold's struggles in Madrid
item.description: Trent Alexander-Arnold is currently third-choice right-back at Real Madrid - where does his future lie?

item.title: Who am I? Plus today's other quizzes
item.description: Test your ball knowledge against today's Who Am I?, Five in Five and Brainteaser.

item.title: Chelsea beat 10-man Man Utd to pile more pressure on Carrick
item.description: Lisandro Martinez is sent off for Manchester United as they suffer a 2-0 defeat against Chelsea at Stamford Bridge to pile more pressure on under-fire manager Michael Carrick.

item.title: Brighton pick up first away league victory over Man City
item.description: Brighton pick up their first away league victory at Manchester City, winning 1-0 to condemn City to a second successive Premier League defeat.

item.title: Coventry out of bottom three with win over struggling Sunderland
item.description: Frank Lampard's Coventry City lift themselves out of the relegation zone after beating struggling Sunderland, who remain rooted to the bottom of the Premier League table.

item.title: Enciso's stunning goal earns Ipswich draw at Hull
item.description: Julio Enciso scores the equalising goal for Ipswich as they draw 2-2 with Hull at the MKM Stadium.

item.title: Spurs revival continues with victory over 10-man Crystal Palace
item.description: Jean-Philippe Mateta was shown an early red card as Crystal Palace lose 2-0 at Tottenham to increase the pressure on manager Pierre Sage.

item.title: Evanilson scores again as Bournemouth beat Leeds
item.description: Forward Evanilson continues his fine goalscoring form by netting in a fourth Premier League match in a row to help Bournemouth defeat Leeds United at the Vitality Stadium.

item.title: Thiago on target as Brentford beat Forest
item.description: Igor Thiago's second-half goal helps Brentford to their first win in five as they beat Nottingham Forest 2-0 at the Gtech Community Stadium.

item.title: Suzuki mistake gifts Fulham point at Villa
item.description: Aston Villa goalkeeper Zion Suzuki's second-half mistake sees Fulham secure a 1-1 draw at Villa Park after Nicolas Jackson had given the hosts the lead.

item.title: Martinez's 'inexplicable' 83 seconds cost Man Utd and Carrick
item.description: Manchester United defender Lisandro Martinez condemned for costly red card in 2-0 defeat to Chelsea at Stamford Bridge.

item.title: Man Utd enquire about Toney - Sunday's gossip
item.description: Manchester United enquire about Ivan Toney's availability, Barcelona are tracking Chelsea winger Estevao Willian, Jean-Philippe Mateta is set to leave Crystal Palace in January, plus more.

item.title: Maresca's big test is to address mounting Man City issues
item.description: Enzo Maresca enjoyed a flawless start as Manchester City manager, winning his first seven Premier League games in charge, but the honeymoon period is now over.

item.title: Glasner fears he will be next Forest sacking if wins don't follow
item.description: Nottingham Forest head coach Oliver Glasner warns he will be the fifth sacking in just over a year by the club, unless results improve soon.

item.title: Kilmarnock 'need support more than ever' but patience wearing thin
item.description: Kilmarnock climb out of bottom spot, but failure to beat 10 men at home adds to gloom at Rugby Park.

item.title: Verbruggen spreads belief as impressive Brighton beat Man City
item.description: Goalkeeper Bart Verbruggen was the man of the moment on Saturday afternoon as he produced an impressive individual display to help Brighton beat Manchester City

item.title: Wednesday appoint former Stockport boss Challinor
item.description: Sheffield Wednesday appoint former Stockport County boss Dave Challinor as their new manager.

item.title: Returning Estevao brings X-factor to strikerless Chelsea
item.description: Morgan Rogers swings the match in Chelsea's favour as Estevao Willian dazzles, making a mystery of his limited action under Xabi Alonso this season.

item.title: 'Best thing is keep your mouth shut' - Mourinho on Mbappe-Mao row
item.description: Real Madrid head coach Jose Mourinho says the "best thing is to keep your mouth shut" but backs Kylian Mbappe following reaction to his Mao Zedong remark.

item.title: Coventry, Ipswich, Hull - promoted trio enjoy positive starts
item.description: The three teams have collected a respectable 31 points in total after nine games, and all currently sit above the relegation zone.

item.title: Russo rescues late point for Arsenal against Villa
item.description: Chastity Grant's first-half strike for Aston Villa is cancelled out by a late header from Alessia Russo, as Arsenal record another draw at home in a frustrating afternoon.

item.title: Has Martinez become a liability for Man Utd?
item.description: Match of the Day pundits Danny Murphy and Stephan Warnock analyse Lisandro Martinez's performance in Manchester United's 2-0 defeat to Chelsea, where the Argentinian defender was sent off.

item.title: Carrick bemoans Man Utd defending in loss to Chelsea
item.description: Manchester United manager Michael Carrick takes issue with his side's defending, particularly for the first goal they conceded in their 2-0 defeat by Chelsea in the Premier League.

item.title: Kane misses Bayern penalty before late Dortmund goal earns draw
item.description: Harry Kane misses from the spot as Bayern Muich are held to a 2-2 draw with Borussia Dortmund in Der Klassiker after Fabio Silva's late equaliser.

item.title: How 'brave & balanced' Brighton beat Man City
item.description: Match of the Day pundits Danny Murphy and Stephan Warnock analyse Brighton's impressive 1-0 victory over Manchester City, with Warnock praising the balance of the Seagulls squad.

item.title: Tottenham mood 'totally different' - De Zerbi
item.description: Tottenham manager Roberto De Zerbi said the mood at the club is "totally different" after picking up a third straight league victory with a 2-0 win over Crystal Palace.

item.title: AC Milan score three first-half goals to seal derby victory over Inter
item.description: Christian Pulisic, Adrien Rabiot and Diego Moreira score in the first-half to help AC Milan to a 3-1 victory over city rivals Inter Milan in the first Milan derby of the season in Serie A.

item.title: More goals for Lankshear, home woes for Hammers - Aaron McLean's EFL Takeaways
item.description: BBC Final Score pundit Aaron McLean looks at the weekend's talking points in the EFL, including Middlesbrough and West Ham United.

item.title: Kane beat Mbappe to Ballon d'Or by just 28 points
item.description: Voting figures show Harry Kane beat second-placed Kylian Mbappe to the men's Ballon d'Or by one of the tightest winning margins in the award's history.

item.title: 'We fell behind' - what does new San Siro deal mean for AC Milan and Inter?
item.description: BBC Sport explores the plans for AC Milan and Inter's new stadium, and how powerful naming rights for new arenas can be

item.title: Sutton's predictions v Bad Day At The Office star John Hannah
item.description: BBC Sport football expert Chris Sutton takes on Bad Day At The Office star John Hannah, plus the BBC readers and AI with his predictions for this weekend's Premier League fixtures.

item.title: Is double drop from the Premier League becoming more common?
item.description: Back-to-back relegations to the third tier of English football are becoming more common and this season Burnley could make it a hat-trick after Luton Town and Leicester.

item.title: Manager ins and outs - 2026-27
item.description: BBC Sport tracks all the manager ins and outs in the Premier League, Scottish Premiership, Women's Super League, English Football League and National League.

item.title: All done deals in September & October 2026
item.description: Check out the significant signings and departures in the Premier League, Scottish Premiership, EFL and Women's Super League.

item.description: BBC Sport's Ask Me Anything team explains why Cole Palmer's red card suspension will not rule him out of Chelsea's Premier League match against Manchester United.

item.title: Who is close to a yellow card suspension in Champions League?
item.description: BBC Sport's Ask Me Anything team explains what the rules are regarding yellow card suspensions in this season's Champions League

item.title: Were any current Man City players signed during charges period?
item.description: BBC Sport's Ask Me Anything team looks at whether any Manchester City players were signed during the time the club have been found guilty of breaching the Premier League's financial rules.

item.title: Why are some football shin pads so small?
item.description: Our Ask Me Anything team explore why some football shin pads are so small, and what the laws are around wearing them.

item.title: Who has scored against the most Premier League teams?
item.description: BBC Sport's Ask Me Anything team looks at which players have scored against the most teams in Premier League history

item.description: BBC Bitesize Careers finds out about the jobs people do on Match of the Day and how they got their roles

item.title: 'My job combines my passion for gaming and football'
item.description: CJ discusses his route into his job testing football video games. Find out more about his role, career progression and top tips for getting into a similar role.

item.title: How to become a football referee
item.description: Fifa and NIFL Premiership referee, Louise Thompson, explains her career path. Find out more about referees' salary, skills and training.

item.title: 'I persuaded my club to give me a job as a content creator'
item.description: Jacob discusses his route into his job as a content creator for a football club. Find out more about his role, career progression and top tips for getting into a similar role.

item.title: Ten unusual jobs in football
item.description: What are some of the lesser known jobs in football? BBC Bitesize Careers finds out!

item.title: McInnes demands more after delivering Rangers' trophy chance
item.description: Derek McInnes knows there is room for improvement as he steers in-form Rangers to the Premier Sports Cup final with a 1-0 win over Aberdeen.

item.title: The Unpromotables: Germany's league champions who can't go up
item.description: German football is grappling with a sum that doesn't add up - four promotion spots for five league champions.

item.title: The part-timers who won three Wembley finals in a row
item.description: You probably knew Pep Guardiola's Manchester City won four League Cups on the bounce between 2018 and 2021 – but another side did the silverware hat-trick first.

item.title: A team that offered hope... then, four months later, Hamas attacked Israel
item.description: Can the potential of a golden generation of Israel's footballers, in sport and society, be realised?

item.title: Arsenal had more than 20 players on shortlist to capitalise on title win
item.description: Senior football correspondent Sami Mokbel goes inside Arsenal's bid to capitalise on their Premier League title and strengthen their squad this summer.

item.title: 73 goals from dropping deep - we ask Kane to break down how he did it
item.description: Harry Kane was the highest goalscorer in Europe last season, yet he plays like a midfielder. We ask him to break down his game.

item.title: Life as a Wag in the transfer window
item.description: What is life like for footballers' families during the transfer window where a last-minute deal means you need to uproot your life and move hundreds of miles?

item.title: The summer that changed Welsh football
item.description: A decade on from Euro 2016, key figures tell BBC Sport Wales the inside story of the summer that changed Welsh football forever.
